speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. I would like to examine the rash closely; could you please show me the affected areas on your upper body and face? Also, have you noticed any hair loss or changes in your fingernails?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. Given your history of working with livestock and rice, have you experienced any weight loss, night sweats, or fever recently?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the combination of a pruritic rash, sensory loss on the palms, and eyebrow thinning, I suspect Hansen's disease. REQUEST TEST: Skin biopsy for acid-fast bacilli.
